description: Independent out-of-distribution evaluation benchmark for genomic pipeline failure prediction
evaluation_context: Independent templates and manual workflows isolated from dataset generator lineages

samples.pipeline_text:
FASTQC --in sample_R1.fastq --out qc_R1.html
FASTQC --in sample_R2.fastq --out qc_R2.html
TRIMMOMATIC --in sample_R1.fastq --out sample_R1_val.fq --minlen 40
BWA MEM --ref reference_genome.fa --in sample_R1_val.fq --out sample_pe.sam --threads 16
SAMTOOLS VIEW --in sample_pe.sam --out sample_pe.bam --threads 8
SAMTOOLS SORT --in sample_pe.bam --out sample_pe_sorted.bam --threads 8
SAMTOOLS INDEX --in sample_pe_sorted.bam
GATK HaplotypeCaller --ref reference_genome.fa --in sample_pe_sorted.bam --out pe_variants.vcf

FASTQC --in sc_reads.fq --out sc_qc.html
TRIMMOMATIC --in sc_reads.fq --out sc_trimmed.fq --minlen 30 --slidingwindow 4:15

BWA MEM --ref grch38.fa --in targeted_panel.fastq --out targeted.sam --threads 4
SAMTOOLS SORT --in targeted.sam --out targeted.bam --threads 4
SAMTOOLS INDEX --in targeted.bam

samples.architecture: Whole exome variant calling with custom filenames
samples.pipeline_text:
FASTQC --in wes_sample_01.fastq --out wes_01_fastqc.html
BWA MEM --ref hs37d5.fa --in wes_sample_01.fastq --out wes_01.sam --threads 12
SAMTOOLS VIEW --in wes_01.sam --out wes_01_raw.bam --threads 6
SAMTOOLS SORT --in wes_01_raw.bam --out wes_01_coordsort.bam --threads 6
SAMTOOLS INDEX --in wes_01_coordsort.bam
GATK HaplotypeCaller --ref hs37d5.fa --in wes_01_coordsort.bam --out wes_01_germline.vcf

FASTQC --in ecoli_reads.fastq --out ecoli_qc.html
TRIMMOMATIC --in ecoli_reads.fastq --out ecoli_clean.fq --minlen 50 --slidingwindow 5:25
BWA MEM --ref ecoli_k12.fa --in ecoli_clean.fq --out ecoli.sam --threads 4
SAMTOOLS SORT --in ecoli.sam --out ecoli_sorted.bam
SAMTOOLS INDEX --in ecoli_sorted.bam
GATK HaplotypeCaller --ref ecoli_k12.fa --in ecoli_sorted.bam --out ecoli_snps.vcf

FASTQC --in lib1.fq --out lib1_qc.html
BWA MEM --ref chr21.fa --in lib1.fq --out lib1.sam

samples.architecture: HPC clustered WGS pipeline with high concurrency
samples.pipeline_text:
FASTQC --in hpc_run.fastq --out hpc_run_qc.html
TRIMMOMATIC --in hpc_run.fastq --out hpc_trimmed.fq --minlen 36
BWA MEM --ref hg19.fa --in hpc_trimmed.fq --out hpc.sam --threads 32
SAMTOOLS SORT --in hpc.sam --out hpc.sorted.bam --threads 16
SAMTOOLS INDEX --in hpc.sorted.bam
GATK HaplotypeCaller --ref hg19.fa --in hpc.sorted.bam --out hpc_calls.vcf

FASTQC --in rnaseq.fastq --out rnaseq_qc.html
STAR --genomeDir /ref --in rnaseq.fastq --out rnaseq.bam
SAMTOOLS SORT --in rnaseq.bam --out rnaseq_sorted.bam
SAMTOOLS INDEX --in rnaseq_sorted.bam
